ArrayOfShows.Name: AMERICAN DOCTOR
ArrayOfShows.ShortDescription: From Emmy® Award-winning filmmaker Poh Si Teng, AMERICAN DOCTOR follows three American physicians— Palestinian, Jewish, and Zoroastrian—united by a single oath to save lives. After volunteering in besieged hospitals in Gaza, they return home determined to fight for the patients and colleagues they left behind, taking their battle from the front lines of war to the halls of Congress.

ArrayOfShows.Name: COYOTE VS ACME
ArrayOfShows.ShortDescription: After enduring years of catastrophic product failures at the hands of ACME, Inc., a tenacious, unemployed coyote uncovers a corporate cover-up and spearheads an unhinged battle against the multinational conglomerate that’s been blowing him up in the name of profit. Also, there’s a roadrunner. And dynamite.

ArrayOfShows.Name: HA-CHAN, SHAKE YOUR BOOTY!
ArrayOfShows.ShortDescription: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

ArrayOfShows.Name: A SEPARATION
ArrayOfShows.ShortDescription: Fresh off its Surprise 35! debut, we present a reprise screening of Asghar Farhadi’s monumental Iranian drama A SEPARATION. The Academy Award-winning film is a masterclass in tension, shifting perspectives and the dissolution of marriage in contemporary Iran.

ArrayOfShows.Name: AMITYVILLE: THE EVIL ESCAPES
ArrayOfShows.ShortDescription: As the Evans children mourn their father’s death and move with their mother to a gothic seaside mansion, a mysterious lamp possessed by a demon raises some serious shit. Jessica, the youngest of the household, believes the spirit is her father secretly returning. Nope! A Multicom Films Release.

ArrayOfShows.Name: BIRTH
ArrayOfShows.ShortDescription: Jonathan Glazer’s underrated and misunderstood masterpiece led by an astonishing Nicole Kidman follows a recently widowed woman wallowing in immense grief until she is visited by a young boy claiming to be her late husband.

ArrayOfShows.Name: AD ASTRA
ArrayOfShows.ShortDescription: An emotionally detached astronaut (Brad Pitt) journeys through the darkest depths of the solar system to find his missing father (Tommy Lee Jones) in this introspective space odyssey from filmmaker James Gray.
